summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for Admin Customer Intelligence Radar actions. Backend radar action contracts passed for coupon, push, manager_alert, and coupon_push_alert with auth gates and no ObjectId/_id serialization leaks. UI radar rows rendered Coupon/Push/Auto buttons and Coupon click showed success toast. One known auth preflight CORS issue remains.

critical.issue: Credentialed CORS preflight response still missing access-control-allow-credentials=true in preview response.

integration_issues.issue: UI exposes Coupon/Push/Auto actions only; standalone Manager Alert trigger is not directly available as a dedicated action button.

action_items: Fix preview edge/ingress preflight headers for credentialed auth OPTIONS requests.
Confirm product decision: if required, add dedicated Manager Alert action button in radar row UI; otherwise document Auto as manager-alert path.
Re-run this suite after CORS fix and any UI action mapping update.
critical_code_review_comments: Radar action backend implementation writes to real collections (coupons/promo_codes, notifications, merchant_alerts, pos_security_alerts, customer_radar_actions) and strips _id from responses.
API service correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and includes /api prefixed admin customer intelligence routes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 174 added radar/action endpoint tests for unauth/non-admin rejection and action types coupon, push, manager_alert, coupon_push_alert. All passed except existing auth preflight CORS contract test. UI run confirmed customer-intelligence panels render and Coupon action toast appears after click.
rca of the issue: CORS middleware behavior in preview still appears overridden at edge/ingress for OPTIONS /api/auth/login, causing missing access-control-allow-credentials even though app-level routes and auth flows function correctly.
